title: Chris Kelly's band and its musicians
summary: Robinson played with Kelly longer than any band; members included Mealy Bong, Peter Patton, Marrero bass, and drummer Faiso.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Can you tell us some more about Chris Kelly? I understand you played with him quite a few years.
Oh yeah, I played with him longer than I did any band.
What kind of a trumpet was he and what kind of a leader? I never did know him at all and he didn't make any records so we don't know much about him.
No, well... He was a pretty good ragtime corner player.
Who else was in the band too while you were there? Well a fella by the name of...

Mealy Bong that was one of his old... Yeah, we know him. ...clanet players. And then Peter Patton used to play banjo and then Marrero boys one named Lowndes he playing bass. Oh yeah. He's still living, he's still around. Yeah. And Faiso drummer, well he played drum with us some. We had Big Willie Phillip, Bill Phillip, well he played drums some. We had several drum players.
Faiso, was that his real name or was it that...
No, that's all I know is Faiso. Faiso. But he was a hell of a drummer.
Yeah, absolutely. He left with me and I never know what happened to him.
I never did see him, I'm not sure.
Didn't someone, someone that spoke to you concern me? I've heard the name but I never knew much about him. But he was a good drummer. That's indeed. He left with me and he never did come back.
